t08.title: D-shaft
t08.text: Order matters: make the round shaft, chamfer both ends, then cut the flat (1 deep).

t19.title: Boolean: intersect
t19.text: Make two cylinders Ø40 × 40 as **separate parts** (New), one along Z and one along X, both centered on the origin. Then **Boolean → Intersect**. The result is one curved part.

t21.title: Spoked wheel, N spokes
t21.text: Make **N** a Variable. Your model must rebuild without errors for any N. Submit with N = 5 and check the volume for N = 7 too.

t23.title: Servo mount plate
t23.text: The cutout fits a standard servo (40.5 × 20.2). Tab holes are 48 apart along the servo and 10 across.

t24.title: Shooter side plate
t24.text: Origin = bottom-left corner. A combined task: plan the order of features before you start.

t25.title: Grid plate with center window
t25.text: Same 8 mm grid as T12, but the 9 holes in the middle are replaced by a 20 × 20 window. Hint: pattern the holes, then use **Skip instances** in the pattern, or cut the window and delete the extra holes.

t26.title: Rocker arm (one sketch)
t26.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything (outline and all holes) must be in a single fully defined sketch. Draw the top tangent line once and use the sketch **Mirror** about a construction centerline; use the sketch **Circular pattern** and **Linear pattern** tools for the holes.

t27.title: Tensioner plate
t27.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything in a single fully defined sketch. The arc slot is centered on the pivot hole: a belt idler on it swings around the pivot.

t28.title: Triangle link
t28.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything in a single fully defined sketch. Three bosses joined by tangent lines.

t29.title: Hex pocket plate
t29.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything in a single fully defined sketch. Two patterns: one row of 7 and two rows of 6, shifted by half a step.

t30.title: Encoder disk
t30.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything in a single fully defined sketch. Two circular patterns with different counts.

t31.title: Five-window wheel
t31.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything in a single fully defined sketch. Draw one window with its four R3 corners as sketch fillets, then pattern it.

t32.title: Truss rail
t32.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything in a single fully defined sketch. Triangles pointing up and down: two linear patterns, shifted by half a step.

t33.title: Keyhole plate
t33.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything in a single fully defined sketch. Each keyhole is a circle plus a slot: trim the lines inside so one closed outline is left.

t34.title: Triangle gusset with holes
t34.text: Rule: **one sketch, one Extrude**. Everything in a single fully defined sketch. Pattern the holes in 2 directions, then remove the ones that fall outside the triangle.

t35.title: Flange with notches
t35.text: Two sketch circular patterns: 6 holes, and 6 notches on the rim shifted by 30°.
